reason: MSRA50 is unavailable: Chang et al. state 1799 images and 12 classes resized to 32x32, with no URL. A sister paper (arXiv:1411.6241) cites He et al. 2004 for those counts; that bibliographic pointer is the 2005 TPAMI Laplacianfaces paper. He et al. (ICCV 2003 / TPAMI 2005) describe an MSRA collection of 12 people, 64-80 frontal images per person per session, cropped to 32x32, and do not print 1799 or a download URL. Matching 12 classes is not enough. No archive was saved. MSRA-B, MSRA10K, and MSRA-TD500 were not substituted. See benchmarks/msra50/README.md.
